verdict.rationale: AvaTax's CreateTransaction docs say transactions can represent returns as well as sales, and the Managed Returns API embeds tax-return preparation and filing. Nothing in the pack shows that negative or refund amounts actually reduce liability, appear correctly in reporting, and carry into the next filing without manual fixes. Missing for 10: documented credit-note/refund transaction handling with negative amounts, evidence that refunds adjust liability and reporting automatically, evidence of carry-through to the next filing period, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
